## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector participation (≥7/11) and cyclical leadership (Industrials/Energy) — Value/Cyclical style favored.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Industrials lead: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +17.72%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +11.40%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing pockets of strength: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +7.24%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Materials weak: NUE (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -0.12%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples weak: WMT (1W: -7.97% | 1M: +3.04%) CORRECTION, MDLZ (1W: -4.95% | 1M: +2.53%) CORRECTION. Technology shows internal rotation despite leaders — mixed internals vs 1M drag.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (Tech/Industrials dominant in Top 5) — cyclical/value tilt.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: PANW (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -18.06%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -4.37% | 1M: -27.50%) BELOW TREND, NUE (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -0.12%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select Tech and Materials names, reduce exposure to structurally weak names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND; note major short-term reversals in several names (AMZN RECOVERY, GOOGL RECOVERY, PYPL RECOVERY) — tactical opportunities but watch for follow-through.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed but constructive: AAPL (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -10.35%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND — sector showing pockets of ABOVE TREND leadership amid 1M rotation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Positive internals with dispersion: JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +6.58% | 1M: -25.48%) RECOVERY, V (1W: -1.00% | 1M: -1.13%) BELOW TREND — Financials supportive of the RISK-ON backdrop but watch select earnings/sentiment names.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Defensive but mixed: JNJ (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -16.61%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND — healthcare not leading but provides rotation alternatives.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor cyclical/value exposure (Industrials, Energy, select Financials) — examples: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to structurally weak Tech names (ORCL, INTC, PANW) showing BELOW TREND signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND — strong earnings follow-through; AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND — semicap momentum. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND — news-driven weakness, TSLA (1W: -1.26% | 1M: -4.55%) BELOW TREND — product/strategy headlines weigh.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Industrials (Breadth positive, leaders DE/GE/CAT ABOVE TREND) and Energy (OXY/CVX ABOVE TREND) — breadth supportive. BEARISH: Materials and Consumer Staples (Materials: NUE BELOW TREND; Consumer Staples: WMT CORRECTION) — defensive lag.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
DE breakout continuation above prior highs (follow earnings momentum). AMAT sustain above recent 1W gap for semicap strength. ORCL failure to reclaim short-term resistance would confirm BELOW TREND continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
DE (+80): Deere surged on upbeat earnings/guidance — price confirming strength: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND. JNJ (+55): DePuy sale talk; price in CORRECTION: JNJ (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION — watch for corporate action confirmation. PFE (+55): Positive trial results; PFE (1W: -2.99% | 1M: +4.66%) CORRECTION — news bullish but short-term pullback.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ORCL (-60): Large negative headlines and price confirming distribution: ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND. TSLA (-55): Model lineup headlines and price confirming weakness: TSLA (1W: -1.26% | 1M: -4.55%) BELOW TREND. BA (-55): Starliner issues and selling pressure; BA (1W: -3.06% | 1M: -7.21%) BELOW TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style with Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive and concentrated leadership in Industrials/Energy/Tech. DE, OXY and AMAT showing clear strength (DE ABOVE TREND, OXY ABOVE TREND, AMAT ABOVE TREND). Key risk: several large-cap Tech names (ORCL, INTC, PANW) and media/product headlines (TSLA, BA) show BELOW TREND/sentiment divergence — watch for trend breaks.
